name: geofuego-harmonization
description: MODIS→VIIRS-equivalent harmonized fire-hotspot calendar for Argentina, 2000→today (NASA Space Apps 2026, GeoFuego.com.ar)

scripts.build: node scripts/02_grid.mjs && node scripts/03a_static_sources.mjs && node scripts/03b_coverage.mjs && node scripts/03_aggregate.mjs && node scripts/04_factors.mjs && node scripts/05_loyo.mjs && node scripts/05c_aoi_error.mjs && node scripts/06_harmonize.mjs
scripts.validate: node scripts/05_loyo.mjs --ablation --tag=_ablation && node scripts/05b_external_validation.mjs && node scripts/05d_ha_per_hotspot.mjs && node scripts/05e_enso.mjs && node scripts/audit_static_sources.mjs
scripts.figures: python3 scripts/fig_factor_map.py 8 TA && python3 scripts/fig_factor_map.py 8 T && python3 scripts/fig_external_validation.py Argentina && python3 scripts/fig_ablation.py
scripts.all: npm run fetch && npm run build && npm run validate && npm run figures
